ANOMALY LOG UPDATE
Dr. Emilia Gates, Operation Victoria
SUBJECT:	Anomaly Log Post-Incident Analysis - Historical Maritime Wreck “Ranger” (Reference: Event VIC-0531)

For as long as OpVic has been established, the remnants of an aged wooden sailing vessel have sat half-buried along the tidal flats west of Sector Bravo-8. We assumed it to be the wreckage of a colonial merchant craft, too degraded to justify extensive analysis at the time with many other rift anomalies present.

However, after extensive cross-referencing of rigging layouts and historical registries, we are now able to speculate the vessel’s likely identity: the Ranger, a sloop captained by infamous pirate John “Calico Jack” Rackham. The ship was believed to have been destroyed by British forces in 1720, with no known remnants ever recovered. Unbeknownst to the world, it appears that the Ranger has been here, resting undisturbed and embedded in the sand.

It is difficult to speculate on the conditions under which it entered the rift. Despite the erosion, a few core structural elements remain intact: cannon ports, deck rail, and several fixtures bearing early 1700s craftsmanship. But the vessel's apparent lack of collision or fire damage suggests it may have entered this universe through a low-energy rift and washed ashore centuries ago (by local measure).

As the Ranger predates our presence on this island, it stands to reason that other objects, perhaps even older than this ship, may lie hidden or misidentified throughout the archipelago. A historical reevaluation of other shoreline wreckage sites is now underway.

Dr. Emilia Gates

ANOMALY LOG UPDATEDr. Emilia Gates, Operation VictoriaSUBJECT: Anomaly Log Post-Incident Analysis – Civilian Maritime Disappearance (Reference: Event VIC-0467

At 18:32 local time, watch personnel at the Southern Victoria Outpost on Western Island reported the sudden appearance of a beached vessel along the shoreline. The wreck had not been present even an hour earlier, yet the vessel’s condition suggests prolonged environmental exposure.

Visual assessment identified the boat as a 23-foot cabin cruiser. Though heavily eroded, the registration number was confirmed via side panel etching and matched to the Witchcraft, a yacht reported missing off the coast of Miami in 1967. According to Universe Mundus records, the vessel vanished only one mile offshore after issuing a non-emergency distress call.

Here in Victoria, the Witchcraft has manifested fully deteriorated, lodged in the sand within direct line of sight of our outpost. Its presence was abrupt as if it phase-shifted into position mid-tide. Despite clear signs of long-term degradation, there are no indicators of impact-related damage.

If Witchcraft did breach the Rift and appear now, aged and weathered, it reinforces our working theory: Victoria receives displaced matter along an asynchronous timeline. The past in Universe Mundus can emerge in our present, long after or even before the event itself.

I have recorded coordinates and submitted photographic documentation for archival cross-reference. Given the vessel’s sudden appearance and its proximity to our perimeter, this may be the first known instance of Rift activity occurring in direct view.

Dr. Emilia Gates

ANOMALY LOG UPDATE
Dr. Emilia Gates, Operation Victoria
Subject: Post-incident analysis - U.S. Naval Aviation Event “Flight 19” (Reference: Event VIC-0191)

This morning, I received a dispatch from OpVic Headquarters in Universe Mundus. A multiversal anomaly was detected: five aircraft, a U.S. Navy training squadron, vanished into a high-altitude Rift above the Atlantic. HQ flagged the event, Flight 19, as active and advised my team to prepare for a possible incursion.

However, here in Victoria, the story has already come to an end. I instructed ground teams to re-check a known crash site in Sector Charlie-7, where we had previously catalogued an aviation wreckage. A second pass with updated reference material confirmed it: the wreck is remnants of Flight 19.

The fuselage is fragmented and deeply oxidized, but the tail numbers match precisely. We recovered some human remains, those of a pilot who had attempted to make camp in a nearby cave. The other four aircraft remain lost to us, and perhaps still lost in time and space as well.
This discovery confirms a troubling conclusion: time does not flow consistently between our worlds. 

While Flight 19 is only now being reported as active in Universe Mundus, they have already crashed and perished here in Universe Sinum. This is not the first time we've noted desynchronization between timelines, but the clarity of this case is unsettling. 

Whenever I am able to send communications back across the rift, the Flight 19 incident must be reclassified from active recovery to historical closure. I will record the coordinates and remains for archival purposes.

Dr. Emilia Gates

ANOMALY LOG UPDATE
Dr. Emilia Gates, Operation Victoria
Subject: Post-incident analysis - Soviet Naval Encounter (Reference: Event VIC-0327)

At 04:17 GMT, dimensional sensors registered a sudden rift ripple in Quadrant 4-C, followed by extreme pressure displacement and a brief but intense electromagnetic flare consistent with interdimensional stress. Preliminary acoustic readings suggested the rupture of non-native steel under pressure. Within 14 seconds of the breach, a Soviet Foxtrot-class submarine appeared with hull markings confirming identity as B-59.

The vessel manifested with visible hull deformation and severe oxidation, inconsistent with its expected condition if preserved in our timeline. Full biological scans were inconclusive; no life signs were found. However, movement was noted within the control room for approximately 43 seconds post-arrival. 

Most notably, the vessel’s fifteen-kiloton nuclear warhead is still intact and is undergoing stabilization protocols. The presence of a functional nuclear warhead raises serious ethical and procedural concerns. This event predates our operational timeline and may require diplomatic oversight if data is leaked. 

The warhead's radiation signature is currently stable, but anomalously “phased” and drifting slightly out of sync with baseline quantum decay. More pressingly, it confirms that nuclear materials are not neutralized by Rift passage. This phenomenon may provide insight into how time behaves under Rift displacement. The implication is staggering: radioactive material aging at a different rate than its environment.

Dr. Emilia Gates
